ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) patches concentrated at the distal lobe tips accounting for roughly 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region spanning the central 75% of both lobes. Symmetrical high-intensity blobs located at the terminal ends of left and right lobes. Scattered, non-contiguous high-intensity speckling present across the interior of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and a depth approximately 1/8th of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips where texture becomes irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the median notch to the tips; leading edge displays a slight convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured pixels (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the extreme distal margins of both lobes. Multiple individual circular white spots (1-3 pixels diameter) visible on the left lobe's interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel, high-contrast diagonal linear tracks (rake marks) on the lower-left lobe, oriented at roughly a 45-degree angle from the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and associated irregular tissue deformation on the outer margins of both lobe tips.
